acutechgroupinc-acutechgroupinc:greenhou.title: Principal / Sr. Principal Process Safety Consultant - Singapore
acutechgroupinc-acutechgroupinc:greenhou.description: Who We Are: AcuTech Group, Inc. is a premier provider of process safety, risk management, chemical security, industrial fire protection engineering, and emergency management services. We have deep expertise in Process Safety Management (PSM), Training, Implementation, Auditing, Process Hazard Analyses (PHA’s), Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOPs), Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA) and Facility Siting, among other engineering and consulting services. AcuTech has deep specialization in the oil and gas, chemical, LNG, petrochemical, renewables, hydrogen, and other industries handling hazardous materials. Our industry experts deliver these services to leading privately held and publicly traded companies, as well as government agencies, and state sponsored entities globally. Position Description: AcuTech Consulting Group is growing rapidly and seeking highly qualified and motivated Senior and/or Principal Process Safety Consultants in Singapore to help fuel our growth. Candidates would join a highly respected team of industry leading PSM experts on challenging projects for many of the world’s largest corporations. These positions offer an excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth. AcuTech is well established, successful, and growing company that offers competitive salary, bonus and benefits based on experience and position. Positions offered would be remote / hybrid in nature, with travel to client sites required. What to Expect: You will join a dynamic growing international company, working alongside some of the best and brightest in the field with some of the most well-known names in the industry. You will enjoy the flexibility of working from your remote-based location, traveling as necessary to the client site. You will have opportunities to meaningfully contribute right away while training and growing in related areas. Your ability to work cross-functionally means assignments may include all aspects of Process Safety: PSM program development, auditing, process hazards analysis (PHA), and qualitative and quantitative risk assessment, including hazard identification, accidental release scenario development, consequence modeling (dispersion, fire, explosion), frequency analysis (including Event Tree and Fault Tree analysis), presentation of risk results, and report preparation. What You’ll Do: As part of AcuTech’s Singapore team, you will work directly with clients on projects spanning all aspects of process safety and risk management in Singapore and Asia. Successful candidates will proactively apply engineering and problem-solving skills to meet challenging safety and business objectives while seeking out leadership and growth opportunities. Candidates must have high technical acumen, be self-motivated, independent, organized, able to work effectively under direction of senior engineers, and handle multiple work assignments and projects. What’s Required: 8 to 15+ years’ experience required self-motivated, independent, organized, able to work effectively under direction of senior engineers, handle multiple work assignments and projects and seek professional growth and development. BS/MS in related engineering field (chemical, process safety or relevant discipline) or associated science degree. Relevant experience in, process safety, process safety management, health, safety and environment (HSE), related experience in process or engineering design environment, manufacturing operations, and/or consulting environment. Ability to develop consulting business, including developing proposals and making presentations Self-motivated, independent, strong leadership and organizational skills. Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, interpersonal skills, and client service. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and facilitation skills and a consultative approach in supporting customer projects. We provide commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, project management and other consulting services to mission critical industries. We are global partner in providing professional services to enhance operational performance and reliability. We deliver consistently. Expertly. Completely. Role Overview The Senior Commissioning Manager is responsible for end-to-end site commissioning leadership and execution of large-scale, mission-critical Data Center projects. This role provides strategic and operational oversight of mechanical, electrical, and commissioning activities from mobilization through client handover. The position requires strong expertise in hyperscale or enterprise Data Center environments, ensuring that all site activities are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to Tier-level performance standards. The Senior Commissioning Manager serves as the primary on-site authority and is accountable for multi-site coordination, commissioning team performance, stakeholder alignment, and commissioning readiness across projects. Key Responsibilities: Site Leadership • Lead and oversee the commissioning of multiple Data Center commissioning sites. • Establish standardized site execution strategies aligned with corporate and client objectives. • Prepare Commissioning implementation plans/ Commissioning management plan. • Provide leadership to Site Managers, Construction Managers, and commissioning teams. • Ensure consistency in safety, quality, and commissioning delivery standards across all project locations. Mission Critical Project Execution • Direct execution of all mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), and associated commissioning activities for hyperscale Data Centers. • Ensure critical systems achieve reliability, redundancy, and resilience targets prior to energization. • Enforce structured commissioning processes including Level 0–5 commissioning where applicable. • Drive readiness for Integrated Systems Testing (IST) and final client acceptance. Critical Infrastructure Oversight Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning of: • HV/LV distribution systems and substations • Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems • Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS) • Emergency Diesel Generators (EDG) and load bank testing • Battery energy storage systems • Chilled water plants, CRAH/CRAC units, and cooling systems • BMS / EPMS integration • Heat Load testing • Chiller plant management systems • Power quality monitoring and analysis Ensure systems meet uptime, redundancy and SLA requirements. Safety & Compliance Governance • Champion a zero-harm safety culture aligned with OSHA (or equivalent) and regulatory requirements. • Ensure full compliance with statutory approvals, electrical inspectorate requirements, and local authority regulations. • Conduct site audits/inspections and implement corrective actions where required. Stakeholder & Client Management • Act as senior on-site representative for clients, consultants, and hyperscale operators. • Lead high-level coordination meetings and provide manager-level reporting on progress, risks, and mitigation plans. • Align all stakeholders on commissioning deliverables, energization milestones, and go-live readiness. Schedule, Risk & Change Management • Drive project execution in line with master program milestones. • Identify cross-site risks, resource gaps, and schedule conflicts. • Collaborate with Project Directors and Commercial teams to manage scope variations, claims, and cost impacts. • Implement recovery plans where project timelines are at risk. Commercial & Performance Accountability • Monitor team performance, productivity, and adherence to our service contracts. • Oversee budget control at site level in coordination with the regional teams. • Validate milestone

embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:0e9c49f.description: About Us We are a small team obsessed with deep thinking, speed, craftsmanship, and a customer-first approach. Our mission is to build the best care experience in healthcare with a 30-year horizon. The founding team brings deep expertise across medicine, product, operations, and engineering. Collectively, we have built multiple 0-to-1 products and scaled companies from inception to over $1B in valuation, $60M+ ARR, and 100M+ MAU. We help physicians achieve independence by making it easier to start, operate, and grow their practices. We believe the future of healthcare will not be driven by large, bureaucratic systems, but by empowered individual physicians. By lowering barriers to practice ownership, we enable doctors to deliver better care for everyone. We are builders, physicians, and operators with decades of combined experience in healthcare and technology—including more than 30 years of hands-on experience running successful independent practices across urgent care centers, surgical centers, and beyond. Our team has also started and helped shape products used by billions at companies such as Meta, Dropbox, Instagram, Coda, and Nomad. We have strong product-market fit ($10M+ ARR in under 14 months). We are profitable and funded by top-tier VCs in the healthcare vertical. The Role This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not just of a roadmap, but of outcomes. You'll take products, workflows, and business-critical problems from 1 to 100, shaping both what we build and how we scale it. You'll operate at every altitude. At 10,000 feet, you'll define product direction, identify high-leverage opportunities, and imagine how AI can fundamentally reinvent the way work gets done. At the one-inch level, you'll become deeply fluent in legal and medical workflows, dogfood the product, work directly with customers, and uncover the friction others miss. You'll be scrappy, hands-on, and close to the work. You'll turn real-world insight into products people trust and rely on, while continuously testing, learning, and improving. You're a systems thinker with the imagination to design truly AI-native experiences—and the operational discipline to build the processes, feedback loops, and systems that make those experiences better over time. What You'll Do • Lead the end-to-end development of new 0→1 products, from problem definition through launch and iteration. • Develop product strategy, define the roadmap, and make clear trade-offs in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. • Partner closely with engineering and design to prototype quickly using foundation models, agents, retrieval systems, and other emerging AI capabilities. • Translate insights into product requirements, user stories, success metrics, and launch plans. • Design human-in-the-loop experiences that combine AI capabilities with appropriate review, escalation, and operational controls. • Build evaluation frameworks to measure product quality, model performance, reliability, safety, and business impact. • Roll up your sleeves to be involved in the operations, improve processes, and close feedback loops. • Establish the operating rhythms, measurement, and processes needed to scale successful products. • Use data and qualitative feedback to prioritize opportunities and continuously improve the product. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab7876a6-791c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Imaging Clinical Research Scientist based in the United States. This is a senior scientific role focused on advancing diagnostic radiopharmaceutical imaging programs across oncology, immunology, and cardiovascular disease. You will shape clinical development strategies from early-stage studies through registration and support the translation of innovative imaging approaches into clinical practice. The role combines disease biology, biomarker science, molecular imaging expertise, and clinical trial execution. You will serve as a scientific authority across imaging modalities including PET, SPECT, CT, and MRI. Working closely with physicians, scientists, imaging specialists, and external partners, you will influence study design, imaging methodologies, and biomarker strategies. The position offers the opportunity to evaluate emerging technologies, quantitative imaging methods, and AI-driven approaches in a highly collaborative environment. This is an impactful opportunity for a translational scientist seeking to contribute to programs designed to improve diagnosis, patient selection, and disease monitoring. Serve as a subject-matter expert in molecular imaging modalities, including PET, SPECT, CT, and MRI, with applications such as vascular and myocardial inflammation, autoimmune disease activity, atherosclerotic plaque, and cardiac amyloidosis. Analyze and interpret molecular imaging data, including tracer biodistribution, tumor localization, dosimetry considerations, longitudinal response, and quantitative imaging biomarkers. Evaluate imaging performance measures such as sensitivity, specificity, standardized uptake values (SUVs), and tumor-to-background ratios. Provide scientific and strategic input into the development, validation, and quantitative assessment of advanced image-analysis methodologies. Lead cross-functional initiatives and coordinate with CROs, academic institutions, technology providers, software developers, and imaging equipment manufacturers. Monitor emerging advances in molecular imaging, quantitative modeling, and artificial intelligence, identifying opportunities to incorporate innovative approaches into clinical development. Communicate scientific findings through internal presentations, conference abstracts, and peer-reviewed publications. Requirements: PhD in a relevant scientific or technical discipline. At least 5 years of clinical development experience, including a minimum of 3 years in an industry environment. Experience with tracer development and/or clinical imaging research; expertise in oncology, immunology, and/or cardiology is strongly preferred. Strong scientific knowledge of molecular imaging and experience interpreting PET/CT, SPECT/CT, or related imaging datasets. Our venture capital strategy backs exceptional founders at the earliest stage—often before an idea is fully formed—and provides first institutional capital and an unmatched degree of strategic leverage and domain expertise through exit. Our venture buyout strategy partners with proven management teams through control investments and delivers outsized value by rewiring core products and workflows with AI. Since inception in 2018, Redesign and our portfolio companies have touched the lives of more than 15 million patients, raised over $1.5 billion from premier institutional, sovereign, and strategic investors, and built distinctive partnerships with marquee healthcare organizations and senior leaders around the world. Redesign is based in New York and has offices in Bengaluru, Los Angeles, and Riyadh. ABOUT THE JOB: We are hiring a Senior Technical Recruiter to have a meaningful impact as we scale our global healthcare innovation platform. This person will work closely with our Technology team and hiring managers to define, optimize, and execute talent attraction strategies across internal hiring and our talent ecosystem. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to strategic priorities like global expansion, founder identification, and portfolio company talent advisory. You primary focus will be scaling a technology practice that combines a frontier applied AI lab with deep healthtech investing expertise. Our ambitious technologists have founded companies worth more than two billion dollars, built systems that serve hundreds of millions of patients, providers, and expert users, and run inside NASA, CIA, and 90% of the Fortune 500. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: - 8+ years of recruiting experience in a technology startup. southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:b87295.title: Brand Designer
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:b87295.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. We're looking for a Brand Designer to define and shape how Profound looks and feels across every channel, from campaigns and events to the visual systems that scale our brand as we grow. This is a hands-on design role. The Brand Designer works closely with the Creative Director and Brand lead to shape the visual language of the brand, build the systems that make it scalable, and push it into new territory as Profound expands. You'll sit on the marketing team and collaborate closely with content, demand gen, product, and leadership. You'll be the person in the room with a strong opinion on what the brand should look like, with the craft to back it up. WHAT YOU'LL DO Define and evolve the visual brand. You will shape the look and feel of Profound across all brand touchpoints: campaigns, website, events, social, and beyond. You'll build the systems to get it there consistently. Build flexible, scalable design systems. You'll create and maintain a brand design system that gives the broader team, including our Visual Designer, the building blocks to execute on-brand work at speed. Systems that hold up under pressure and leave room to push. Design campaign creative. You'll work on visual direction for marketing campaigns from concept through execution, ensuring every asset, digital and physical, tells a coherent, compelling story about what Profound is and why it matters. Shape brand experiences. From in-person conferences and events to OOH activations, you'll extend the brand into physical and experiential formats. You'll think about how the brand feels, not just how it looks. Push the creative bar. You'll participate in design reviews alongside the Brand lead and Creative director, and be a visible standard-setter for craft across the marketing team. You'll make the work around you better. Experiment and challenge. Profound's visual identity has room to grow. We want a designer who can bring their ideas to life and execute on them, and who is curious about where the brand could go next. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 5+ years of experience in brand design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual identity work, not just execution - A clear, opinionated point of view on typography, color, layout, and composition, with the ability to defend creative decisions clearly - Experience building and maintaining brand systems that work across digital and physical formats - Proven ability to design campaign creative from concept through final delivery - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills: you work well with marketers, writers, and leadership, and you know how to align stakeholders without losing your creative conviction - Deep proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite - Comfort managing multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment and making independent priority calls - A high bar for craft and the discipline to hold it under deadline pressure BONUS POINTS - Motion design or animation experience - Experience designing for SaaS, martech, or data/AI products - Background in experiential or event design - Familiarity with AI tools in a creative workflow LOCATION This role is based in New York, NY and works in-office. summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a skilled supervisor to drive results. This individual will need to be the gold standard in all our processes, so attention to detail and high drive to win is a must. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere. We need a dedicated team member that has experience in a supervisory role, and a willingness to learn the car wash industry.
